title: SAP S/4HANA Order to Cash — Customer Stories

stories.challenge: Volvo operated fragmented ERP landscapes across 15+ legal entities with inconsistent credit exposure visibility, manual payment reconciliation, and high DSO driven by disputes and unallocated cash.
stories.solution: Consolidated onto SAP S/4HANA with FSCM Credit Management for real-time global exposure, ML-assisted cash application for automated payment matching, and SD Order Management for ATP-integrated order processing across all channels.
stories.keyMetric: DSO reduced by 18 days; 85% of incoming payments auto-matched on first pass

stories.challenge: Scania faced growing e-invoicing mandates across 30+ countries and a high manual effort in billing document creation, with order management fragmented between dealer EDI channels and direct customer portals.
stories.solution: Deployed SAP S/4HANA Billing & e-Invoicing for country-specific compliance automation and SD Order Management to unify multi-channel order capture with automated pricing determination.
stories.keyMetric: 100% e-invoicing compliance across mandated markets; billing cycle time cut by 60%

stories.challenge: Caterpillar's dealer network generated high volumes of disputed invoices and unresolved deductions, with collections teams working across disconnected tools and no integrated promise-to-pay visibility. Cash application was heavily manual, driving delays in AR clearing.
stories.solution: Implemented SAP FSCM Collections & Dispute Management for intelligent worklist prioritisation and integrated promise-to-pay tracking, alongside SAP Cash Application for automated bank statement matching and real-time AR clearing. SAP Billing & e-Invoicing reduced upstream dispute root causes.
stories.keyMetric: Dispute resolution cycle reduced by 40%; cash application straight-through rate increased to 78%
